name: Crayons Advertising Ltd.
summary: Crayons Advertising Ltd. is an integrated advertising and marketing communications agency operating primarily in India. The company offers a comprehensive range of services, including outdoor, print, electronic media, and digital marketing. Its digital services encompass social media management, website development, search engine optimization, mobile marketing, search engine marketing, email marketing, display advertising, video advertising, and native content alliances. Crayons Advertising also specializes in content creation, branding, graphic design, media planning and buying, event management, and provides strategic advisory services for branding and communications. The company targets a diverse clientele that includes government bodies, public sector undertakings, and various private corporate entities within the Indian market.
